blocks.orig: The Sametu Camp lies in the centre of the famous Serengeti National Park, away from the tourist circuits. It is a great place to watch the Great Migration, which typically passes through from April to May and in November and December, or to just enjoy the central Serengeti for a few nights in other months. The camp enjoys peaceful solitude and panoramic views of the vast open savannah plains and the winding Ngare Nanyuki River that flows close to the camp. It offers 18 spacious safari tents (8 regular tents, 8 suites, and 2 family tents), with each its own ensuite bathroom and a separate hot shower area on an elevated platform. A hot buffet-style dinner with truly delectable foods is served in the dinner tent. Or on your own terrace if you so wish!
blocks.html: Away from the tourist routes, in the centre of the famous Serengeti National Park, you find Sametu Camp. It is an excellent base for seeing the Great Migration, which usually moves through between April and May and in November and December, or simply for spending a few nights in the central Serengeti in other months. The camp is quiet and secluded, with panoramic views over the wide open savannah and the winding Ngare Nanyuki River that runs close by. There are 18 spacious safari tents (8 regular tents, 8 suites and 2 family tents), each with an ensuite bathroom and a separate hot shower area on a raised platform. Dinner is a hot buffet of truly delicious food, served in the dinner tent, or on your own terrace if you prefer!
